blocks.text:
After breakfast at the hotel, at 08:00 we’ll take a guided excursion to Lake Atitlan. During the boat tour, we will visit two indigenous villages located on the shores of the lake. We will also explore Santiago de Atitlan and San Pedro. Throughout the tour, you will get acquainted with local customs and traditions passed down from generation to generation, and you will enjoy magnificent views of the lake.

Lake Atitlan, located within the crater of an extinct volcano, attracts tourists from around the world with its breathtaking beauty against the backdrop of the basalt slopes of the crater covered with tropical vegetation. Sometimes Lake Atitlan is called Gringotenango which means the territory of foreigners. Although the town cannot boast its colonial architecture, the most vibrant place in town is the colorful market, where not only food items but also products from local artisans and industrial goods are sold.

blocks.text: After breakfast at 8:00 AM, we check out from the hotel and head to the border of Honduras, to the enchanting colonial town of Copan. We will transfer to a hotel overlooking Central Square in the charming town of Copan. At 2:30 PM, we begin the tour of the main archaeological site in Copan, which includes the Acropolis, the ball court, the hieroglyphic staircase, the magnificent plaza, and the Maya Sculpture Museum, recognized by experts as a unique Maya sculpture collection in the world. In the museum, you can see a masterpiece – an exact replica of the famous Rosalila Temple discovered in 1989. After the tour, you will have free time to spend at the luxurious hotel or explore the charming town of Copan, and visit numerous shops, restaurants, and cozy sidewalk cafes.
